summary:
The speed feature is implemented in rich/progress.py, with a CHANGELOG entry and test updates. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions, so those checks are unverified. Nothing is committed.

Changes:
- Progress.track: with no total and a non-Sized sequence, the total stays None instead of raising. The inferred total is declared Optional[float] before the branch.
- track(): new last parameter show_speed: bool = True, passed to TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=...). Docstring Args entry added.
- TaskProgressColumn: new show_speed constructor keyword (default False). Class docstring now has a summary and an Args section covering every constructor parameter. New @staticmethod render_speed(speed) scales with filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns Text styled "progress.percentage". render takes the speed branch only when total is None and show_speed is on, using task.finished_speed or task.speed; otherwise the existing path runs unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: one line under Unreleased / Added.
- tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed covering None, 5, 5000, and 8888888. Removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. import pytest is still used by a parametrize decorator.

Choices to check: render_speed passes int(speed) to pick_unit_and_suffix, per the spec. Speeds above 10^12 stay at the ×10¹² suffix with a larger number.
